rules.sentence: The prognosis of urothelial bladder cancer depends on multiple factors.
TNM stage is the single most important prognostic factor of urinary bladder carcinoma.
Invasion of the muscularis propria determines whether the patient's staging is pT1 (NMIBC) or pT2 (MIBC).
